install.label: Install the app

steps.iosSafariShare: Tap Share (the square with an arrow) at the bottom of the screen, or under ⋯.
steps.iosChromeShare: Tap Share (the square with an arrow) at the right end of the address bar.
steps.iosOtherShare: Open the browser's menu and tap Share.
steps.androidAdd: Choose Install app or Add to Home screen.

install.after: Then Rommi opens from your home screen like an app.

caveats.heading: About these stats
caveats.body: Stats follow this device: a new device or cleared browser storage starts fresh; a shared device blends players; and stats don't sync across your devices. On an iPhone or a Mac, Safari clears a site's data after 7 days without a visit unless the app is installed on the home screen, so install it to keep your stats.

rules.heading: Rules
rules.intro: A game has five rounds. Each round has its own contract: the melds you must lay down. At the end of a round, the cards left in your hand count as points. The lowest total after five rounds wins.

rounds.heading: Rounds
rounds.hint: Meet the contract before laying any cards down.

melds.heading: Melds
melds.set: Set of three: three or more cards of the same rank. Suits may repeat, since the game uses 2–3 decks.
melds.straight: Flush: four or more cards in a row, all of one suit.
melds.aceLow: An ace can start a flush, counting as 1.
melds.noWrap: But not both at once: a flush never runs from king through ace to two.
melds.joker: A joker stands in for any missing card.

points.heading: Points
points.hint: Every card left in your hand costs points. A round's points are always a multiple of 5.

privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.lede: What Rommi handles and where. There's no account, email address or phone number.

device.title: On this device
device.body: Your name, a game in progress, results waiting to upload, and your theme and language are kept in this device's browser. Clearing the browser's data removes them. Safari removes them after 7 days without a visit unless the app is installed.

online.title: Online games
online.body: In an online game the room code, the players' names and their scores are stored in Google's Firebase in Finland (europe-north1). A room can be joined with its code for six hours after it opens.

identity.title: Identity
identity.body: Each device gets an anonymous id. Your stats and games are tied to it, not to your name or who you are.

public.title: Highscores are public
public.body: The names and scores of players in a finished online game appear on the Highscores page for everyone using the app, and can't be removed. Use a nickname if you prefer.

photo.title: Counting cards from a photo
photo.body: If you count your points from a photo, the photo is sent to Google's Gemini service to recognise the cards. The app doesn't keep the photo.

errors.title: Error reports
errors.body: When something goes wrong, a report goes to Sentry in the EU. It can include a recording of the moment before the error, with all text masked. Names and room codes are left out.
